transcript:
Header: Q1 2027 Roadmap + Launch Readiness - Product & Eng Sync
Date: 2026-12-16 09:30 UTC | Duration: ~75 minutes
Attendees: Priya, Daniel, Maya, Owen, Samir, Elena, Marcus, Ravi, Jules, Anika
Notes: internal planning; recording for follow-ups and action items

Summary: quick pass over Q1 roadmap, launch readiness checklist for the new Dedicated offering improvements, incident review highlights from last week's regression, and outstanding security/compliance items. Focus on canary plan, SLOs, and perf smoke tests.

[00:00] Priya Kapoor: Okay starting, thanks everyone for joining. we're at 9:30, I'll run through the Q1 priorities and then dive into launch readiness. feel free to interrupt.
[00:22] Elena Gomez: quick note  execs want a one-pager for board by next week, so keep that in mind when we finalize scope.
[00:30] Marcus Huang: yep, we'll need clear tradeoffs especially around dedicated vs hosted defaults for enterprise customers.
[00:45] Priya Kapoor: first slide  roadmap priorities: 1) Dedicated capacity stability and predictable scaling, 2) Private (VPC) GA improvements  onboarding + KMS integration, 3) Redwood Console UX for rollouts (canary/A-B), 4) Optimize improvements: smarter batching + cache hints.
[01:10] Daniel Park: on Dedicated stability, main risks are allocator behavior under burst and our autoscaler oscillation. last week's incident shows a race between the scale-up path and the request router fallback.
[01:30] Samir Patel: yeah the KV cache invalidation path exposed a bug; some requests hit cold KV and caused latency spikes. we mitigated but need a robust test.
[01:52] Maya Lopez: ops perspective  we saw two incidents: one caused by scheduling pressure on the NVidia nodes and another by a misconfigured canary route. both require SLO re-evaluation and an SRE runbook update.
[02:20] Owen Li: for Console rollouts, the UX needs clearer state for canary traffic vs full rollout, plus easier rollback buttons. also, ability to pin model variants per-route.
[02:45] Priya Kapoor: good. next  launch checklist for Q1: 1) perf benchmarks & smoke tests, 2) canary + rollback policies validated, 3) security & compliance signoffs (SOC2/ISO/KMS), 4) docs + runbooks, 5) pricing/packaging confirmation.
[03:10] Ravi Menon: on KMS/HSM, we still have two open items: multi-tenant key isolation in Dedicated and audit log integrity for Private customers. need to confirm mitigations.
[03:30] Jules Tran: deployment timing  marketing needs a stable GA date. prefer Jan 31 window but it's tight.
[03:45] Priya Kapoor: we'll target late January for a limited GA if tests pass, otherwise early Feb. next, incident review from last week  Daniel take us through.
[04:05] Daniel Park: incident overview: production regression after a model variant rollout. sequence: packer build -> new kernel selection -> increased memory pressure -> scheduler thrash -> tail latency spike. root cause: kernel selection fallback didn't account for sequence length distribution, caused some nodes to pick non-quantized kernels.
[04:40] Samir Patel: there was also a mismatch in our model catalog metadata; variant tags were inconsistent so the router sent traffic to a variant without the expected quantization profile.
[05:02] Daniel Park: fix implemented: immediate rollback, pinned catalog metadata, and a postmortem. but we need an automated validation in the deployment pipeline to check kernel/quant profiles.
[05:30] Maya Lopez: SRE actions: 1) enforce a pre-deploy validation job that runs a short inference trace to confirm KV cache and quant profile on nodes, 2) tighten autoscaler thresholds to reduce oscillation.
[05:58] Priya Kapoor: action  Daniel to implement pre-deploy validation and share a spec.
[06:10] Daniel Park: noted. I'll propose a CI job that runs on model rollouts and on infra changes.
[06:22] Owen Li: product question  do we want to expose model variant tags to customers in Console? that would help enterprise debugging.
[06:38] Elena Gomez: yes, but with RBAC control and only for org admins. we don't want leaking model internals to all users.
[06:50] Priya Kapoor: security comment  Ravi?
[07:00] Ravi Menon: agree on RBAC. also, we need encrypted audit logs and retention policies for enterprise customers; compliance demands 7 years for some verticals.
[07:18] Priya Kapoor: okay next topic: canary + rollback policy. current plan: 5% traffic for 30 minutes, health checks on latency + error rates, automatic rollback on threshold breach.
[07:40] Samir Patel: threshold numbers?
[07:45] Priya Kapoor: propose +50% p99 latency or +3% error rate as triggers. open to adjust.
[07:55] Marcus Huang: those seem fine but we should add model quality checks  e.g., a small eval prompt set to ensure generation quality didn't regress.
[08:15] Owen Li: we can wire the eval harness to run during canary and report a small delta metric.
[08:30] Daniel Park: engineering note  running evals adds some latency to rollouts, but it's acceptable if it runs asynchronously and results feed the rollback decision.
[08:45] Maya Lopez: SRE wants a circuit breaker that can take the variant out if it crosses SLOs; also runbooks to manually abort rollouts.
[09:05] Priya Kapoor: good. next, perf smoke tests needed: Dedicated 3-node, 8k context, RBAC-enabled, KMS engaged. Daniel?
[09:20] Daniel Park: I'll run a series of tests: baseline hosted v. dedicated, quantized vs non-quantized, and varying batch sizes. aim to publish a spreadsheet with costs and latency by 2026-12-23.
[09:35] Samir Patel: include KV cache hit-rate curves and prefix caching impact.
[09:45] Priya Kapoor: marketing/ops dependencies  pricing confirmation needed for Dedicated GA. Anika, can you sync with finance on the model for reserved capacity vs burst pricing?
[09:58] Anika Shah: yes will do, need a price floor for enterprise signups.
[10:05] Priya Kapoor: Security/compliance overview  Ravi?
[10:10] Ravi Menon: SOC2 work progressing, but Private customers asked about HSM integration for key rotation. we need an implementation plan or temporary mitigations. also verify audit logging end-to-end for Private installs.
[10:30] Jules Tran: docs  we need onboarding playbook for Dedicated and Private, plus a migration checklist for customers moving from hosted. playbook draft by 2026-12-20?
[10:45] Owen Li: design will help with screenshots and UX flows, aim to have a small tutorial flow in Console for canaries and model pinning.
[11:00] Priya Kapoor: timeline review: next two weeks: finalize roadmap doc (Priya), perf smoke test (Daniel), runbook and canary policy (Maya), security deliverables (Ravi), docs/playbook (Jules/Owen).
[11:20] Marcus Huang: we should include a post-launch monitoring plan: retention for traces, token-level cost dashboards, and golden prompts to detect quality regressions.
[11:40] Priya Kapoor: noted. question from Elena: if we hit blockers on Dedicated, fallback to hosted defaults  what's the user experience?
[11:55] Samir Patel: we have a routing fallback path to compatible model variants in hosted. need to make sure tenancy and data isolation expectations are clear in docs.
[12:10] Priya Kapoor: any other risks?
[12:15] Maya Lopez: capacity limits in some cloud regions for certain GPU types. we should de-prioritize aggressive region expansion until we validate supply.
[12:30] Daniel Park: also, dependency on third-party quant kernels (NVIDIA libs)  we need pinned versions and test matrix.
[12:45] Priya Kapoor: last section: exec one-pager contents. Elena suggested we include 1) launch date range, 2) scope (Dedicated + Private GA items), 3) SLO commitments, 4) expected revenue motion, 5) top risks + mitigations.
[13:05] Elena Gomez: yes keep it concise, the board will want risks and contingency plan.
[13:20] Priya Kapoor: recap of action items and owners (see action items list). any blocking asks?
[13:30] Marcus Huang: nothing blocking from eng, just need test results.
[13:35] Priya Kapoor: great. we'll close. I'll share notes and the roadmap doc by Monday. thanks everyone.

End of meeting.

References: internal deck link (doc: /drive/internal/q1-2027-roadmap-v2), perf spreadsheet placeholder (sheet: /sheets/dedicated-perf-smoke-tests), postmortem ticket #INC-2026-487.
